items.title: Live - Slender Man Cup
items.body: Compete in the Duos Reload or the Duos Zero Build Slender Man Cup now! Top regional performers will receive The Slender Man Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Horrors Worth Facing Together
items.body: Wickedly talented Developers have brought their own horrors to life for Fortnitemares! Explore a Collection of spine-chilling Islands, each with its own twist. Face the fear with friends to unlock the Safety in Numbers Quest.

items.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!
items.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.

items.title: The Horror Is Here
items.body: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches. Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await, including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's Gameplay
items.body: It's showtime! Face down animatronic bosses in Battle Royale, with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor. Defeat any rogue robot you find to possess the suit and finish the fight Fazbear style.
